record.name: CLI operator output texture
record.description: Cross-CLI contract for operator-facing help: ANSI texture when enabled, plain disable paths, stderr-first human help with chainable stdout for scripting.

rationale.why: Operator help should use consistent ANSI/plain texture and stderr-first routing so stdout remains chainable.
problems_solved: No plain-mode disable for piped or NO_COLOR environments
Help on stdout breaks scripts that chain build-commands output

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: ARCH documents stream roles, env/flag matrix, precedence, glyph policy, and NO_COLOR alignment.
how() in build-commands.sh and build-commands-how.test.mjs satisfy stderr-default, plain modes, and stdout overrides.
REQ rationale lists future CLI adopters under the same umbrella contract.
